 The Trail Blazers continue their six game roadtrip in Minnesota against the Anthony Edwards-less Timberwolves, and Schultzy has your instant reaction on the Locked On Blazers POSTCAST! Can Portland continue to establish themselves as one of the top four teams in the Western Conference? Will we see Damian Lillard or Deni Avdija go off for another 30 point performance tonight? Join the Locked On Blazers POSTCAST right after the final buzzer!
